recent_calls.summary: The call was very brief and the agent attempted to engage the user, but the user did not respond and hung up shortly after. No issues or requests were discussed.
The user requested to speak with a representative, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent. The transfer was completed successfully.
The user, John Goodwin, called to reach Daniel Lagars but was asked by the agent for a service address ZIP code. The call ended shortly after without further progress.
The call was very brief, with the agent greeting the user and asking how to assist, but the user hung up immediately without responding.

The user called to reach Christina Wilson but the agent informed them that direct call transfers are not possible and offered to take a message or assist with service questions. The call ended shortly after without further action.
The agent identified the caller and attempted to transfer the call to a live agent for further assistance. The call was successfully transferred shortly after initiation.

The user called Budget and provided their ZIP code 62052. The agent informed the user that service is not available in that area and asked if the user had a different ZIP code to check. The call ended shortly after without further interaction.

Earline called to report an emergency issue with her furnace fan not working and requested service for the same day. The AI agent collected all necessary information, including her home warranty dispatch number and contact details, and confirmed the emergency service request. Earline expressed frustration with the call process and gave a low satisfaction rating, then requested to speak with a live agent, after which the call was transferred.
The user requested to speak to a representative, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent. The transfer was completed successfully without any issues.

The user, Clay, called to confirm if the invoice for services related to his central air conditioning unit was received. The agent, Sophie, informed him that she could not access billing information and transferred the call to the billing team for further assistance.

Brian called to request a quote and book a new water softener installation and a flush of his existing hot water heater. The agent confirmed details, offered available appointment slots, and successfully booked the service for Monday, August 10th at noon. Brian also mentioned his membership in the Budget Savings Club, which the agent noted for potential fee adjustments.

The user called to get service but was frustrated due to a long wait and no response, so they hung up and called back. The agent apologized for the wait and transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.

The user called to deliver a reminder about the Hazelwood School District's zero rate change proposal on the election ballot and then ended the call quickly. The agent attempted to engage but the user ended the call shortly after.

The user called to report that their air conditioning is not working and requested a service visit. The agent confirmed the user's ZIP code and asked how they could assist, but the call ended abruptly after the user asked a question and did not receive a response.

The user, Almeda Billington, called to inquire about the time of their scheduled air conditioning service. The agent confirmed the appointment for 11 AM onwards and then transferred the call to a live operator at the user's request. The call ended with a successful transfer.
The user called to discuss a quote they received and asked if the agent was familiar with it. The agent attempted to assist but then transferred the call to a live agent for further help.

The user called to inquire about the status of their interview and job application. The agent informed the user that they do not have access to hiring updates but would pass the request to the appropriate team. The call was then transferred to a live representative as requested by the user.

The user, Dave Harris, called to reschedule an appointment originally set for August 3rd to August 6th in the morning. The agent collected the service address, callback number, and confirmed no additional instructions or email were needed. The team will follow up on the next business day to confirm the new appointment time.

The user called Budget's after-hours assistant to inquire about service availability. The agent checked two ZIP codes provided by the user, but informed them that service is not available in either area. The call ended without further action.
The call was very brief, with the agent introducing herself but the user hanging up immediately without any interaction.

Thomas Fraese called to clarify a discrepancy between the repair options provided by Budget and American Home Shield for his central air conditioning. He expressed his preference for the repair option approved by AHS rather than the upgrade option proposed by Budget and requested that the work crew be sent to fix the problem as per the AHS plan. The agent documented his concerns and informed him that a representative would contact him on the next business day.

Dennis called to schedule a service appointment for a recall on his central air system, which is not cooling to his desired thermostat setting. He requested a regular service appointment around noon on Monday or Thursday at his home address. The agent noted his preferences and informed him that the team would follow up to confirm the appointment.

Deborah called after hours to report an urgent electrical issue with her air conditioning system that requires immediate attention. The agent documented the issue, flagged it as a priority, and informed Deborah that the team will contact her on the next business day. The agent also provided business hours and confirmed the call details before ending the call.

Deborah called to report that her air handler sparked and her AC stopped working, requiring immediate attention. The agent documented the issue, confirmed the service address and phone number, marked the request as urgent, and informed Deborah that the team will contact her on the next business day. The call ended with no further assistance requested.
The call was very brief with the agent greeting the user and checking if they were still on the line, but the user did not respond and hung up shortly after.

The user, Tori, called to schedule a cooling service appointment to add refrigerant through her home warranty. The agent collected the dispatch number, service address, and preferred appointment time for Monday at 1 PM, and informed Tori that the team would follow up to confirm. Tori declined additional information about maintenance programs and feedback requests before ending the call.

The user called outside of business hours and inquired if the office was open. The agent informed the user about the business hours and offered assistance, but the user declined any further help and ended the call politely.
The call was very brief, with the agent greeting the user and asking how to assist, but the user hung up immediately without responding.

The user called to inquire about service in Illinois and provided their ZIP code. The agent acknowledged the location and asked what type of service the user needed help with, but the call ended shortly after without further interaction.

Anne called to report that her thermostat was not getting power and her air conditioner was not blowing cold air. The agent scheduled a service appointment for Monday at 12 PM and confirmed the details with Anne. Anne requested a callback and declined to provide feedback at the end of the call.

The user requested to be connected to the billing department. The agent informed the user that they do not have direct access to billing information and proceeded to transfer the call to the billing team successfully.

The user called from Guardian Metals and wanted to leave a message for management but did not provide any service address ZIP code or request any services. The call reached voicemail and did not progress further.
The user requested to speak with an employee, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent who could assist further.

The user called to inquire about a job application and mentioned having already interviewed with Mitch Nick Marchesenko. The agent offered to pass along a message to Mitch or Nick and have someone follow up with the user.
The user called to request a different person to come look at their house or to speak with someone else. The agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent who could assist further.

Antoinette Moore called to report that her air conditioner is not cooling her residential rental property, causing discomfort due to heat and her use of a CPAP machine. The agent confirmed details, noted the urgency, and assured that a technician would reach out soon. Antoinette declined maintenance program information and provided positive feedback about the agent's patience and assistance.
The user requested to speak with a live human agent named Siggy and explicitly asked for no AI assistance. The agent acknowledged the request and successfully transferred the call to a live agent.

Steven Fischer called to schedule an appointment for air conditioning service related to his American Home Shield home warranty. The agent collected all necessary details including the issue, preferred appointment time, and confirmed the information with Steven. The call ended with no further questions or feedback from the user.

The user reported that their other AC unit was not running and scheduled a regular service visit for the soonest available appointment, which was booked for August 3rd at 10 AM. The agent confirmed the details and informed the user about the dispatch fee. The call ended positively with the user providing positive feedback.

The user repeatedly stated they were returning a call but did not provide any specific information or request assistance. The agent attempted to assist but the user did not engage further and ended the call.

The user, Emily Shilts, called to get an update on her service request for a non-working air conditioner, which is urgent due to her health concerns. The agent documented the issue, flagged it as urgent, and assured Emily that the team will follow up on the next business day. The call ended with the user satisfied and no further requests.

The user called to inquire about immediate plumbing assistance but indicated the leak was stopped and seemed unsure about the urgency. The agent clarified the situation and asked for the user's full name to proceed, but the user questioned if the agent was a robot. The call ended shortly after without completing the service request.

The user, Brianna from American Home Shield, called after hours to submit a diagnosis to the auto department. The agent collected her contact information and service address and informed her that a team member will follow up on the next business day. The call ended with no further requests from the user.

The user, Geneva, called after hours to schedule an emergency appointment regarding an air conditioned boat. The agent could not connect her to a live representative but assured her that the emergency request was documented and would be prioritized for follow-up on the next business day. Geneva confirmed her preference for the soonest available appointment.

The agent attempted to assist the user but had difficulty understanding the user's request. The user repeatedly asked for an operator, and the agent transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.
The user requested to speak with a live agent, and the initial agent transferred the call to another live agent successfully.

The user called to speak with a representative about their hair conditioning and expressed frustration that the agent was not understanding them. The agent attempted to transfer the call to a live agent who could assist further, and the transfer was successful.
